morphology_overrides.neck: Distinctly long and slender for a pliosaur; significantly longer than the skull, oriented parallel to the frame boundaries for full-length assessment.
morphology_overrides.skull: Small, narrow, and needle-like; optimized for snatching small fish and cephalopods, configured in a strict side-profile view.
morphology_overrides.body: Aerodynamic and gracile; visible transition between the neck and the shoulder girdle, displayed cleanly across its horizontal profile.
morphology_overrides.patterning: Dainty, stippled spots that look like ink-flicks concentrated along the spine, mapped uniformly across its horizontal lateral flank.
morphology_overrides.negative_prompt: thick neck, blocky head, massive skull, heavy torso

pose: The transitional pliosaurid is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original dynamic 'S-Curve' banking turn is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its narrow, needle-like skull, intermediate slender neck, streamlined torso, flippers (flattened toward the camera plane), and tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
